other_conditions: Must be an individual rural youth entrepreneur registered under Krishak Bandhu (New) Scheme, or a group (SKUS, PACS, FPO, FPC, FIG, SHG, etc.) approved/recognized by any government institution
The group must have been successfully operating for at least one year
Minimum project cost/Total Financial Outlay of ₹10,00,000
Applicant must have sufficient land (own/leased/hired) categorized as commercial, bastu, or viti
The group must set up the FMB/FMH in a selected village
A beneficiary or his/her spouse cannot apply for a fresh scheme within four years of the last subsidy release
benefits_summary: Provides an 80% subsidy on the total financial outlay up to Rs 8 lakh, with the beneficiary covering the remaining amount and a mandatory 25% margin deposit; the balance is financed via bank loan.
documents_required: Acknowledgement receipt (print‑out of the online application)
